{
  "derived_under_policy": "SPK-001",
  "workpad_schema": "pfp.po035-public-workpad.v1",
  "prompt_id": "pilot_0000199:po035:experiment-v1:scratchpad:03",
  "stage": "workpad_audit",
  "public_records": [
    {
      "record_id": "r1",
      "carrier": "PO035 §3 causal refinement",
      "kind": "calculation",
      "expression": "E_a(t,x)=min(1,C_a exp[-mu_a (||x||_1-a*v_hop(a)*t)/a]) for t>=0",
      "justification": "Stated envelope form from prompt; C_a,mu_a,a,v_hop(a) are carrier parameters.",
      "status": "PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "record_id": "r2",
      "carrier": "Uniform assumptions",
      "kind": "definition",
      "expression": "c=1 (light speed). a>0 is the lattice pitch. v_hop(a) is a velocity function. mu_a>0 is a decay constant. ||x||_1 is L1 norm. t>=0 is time.",
      "justification": "Explicitly stated to avoid silent assumptions; dilation acts on BOTH t and x with c fixed.",
      "status": "PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "record_id": "r3",
      "carrier": "Physical velocity/time scaling",
      "kind": "definition",
      "expression": "a*v_hop(a) <= c",
      "justification": "Constraint ensuring the argument of exp does not grow unboundedly; derived from the requirement that the bound be physically meaningful.",
      "status": "PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "record_id": "r4",
      "carrier": "Limiting spatial norm",
      "kind": "definition",
      "expression": "||x||_1 = |x_1|+|x_2|+...+|x_n|",
      "justification": "L1 norm definition for the hypercubic comparison graph.",
      "status": "PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "record_id": "r5",
      "carrier": "Bound establishes outside the cone",
      "kind": "law_check",
      "expression": "If ||x||_1 >= a*v_hop(a)*t then E_a(t,x) <= C_a exp[0] = C_a (since exponent <=0). For C_a <= 1 the bound is <=1; the cone exterior has E_a decaying or constant but not growing beyond C_a.",
      "justification": "Sign analysis of exponent under ||x||_1 >= a*v_hop(a)*t.",
      "status": "PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "record_id": "r6",
      "carrier": "Null boundary under convergence rates",
      "kind": "calculation",
      "expression": "Null boundary condition: a*v_hop(a)*t = ||x||_1. Rate analysis: if a*v_hop(a) -> c rapidly, the cone approaches the light cone ||x||_1 = c*t. If a*v_hop(a) -> 0, the cone collapses to the origin.",
      "justification": "Limiting cases of the exponent sign change.",
      "status": "PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "record_id": "r7",
      "carrier": "Causal order and Minkowski metric scale",
      "kind": "obligation",
      "expression": "Causal order alone does not identify the Minkowski metric scale; a conformal factor is undetermined. The L1 norm used here yields a diamond-shaped cone, not the circular light cone of Minkowski metric unless a rescaling is imposed.",
      "justification": "Category-theoretic observation: causal order + cone structure determines metric up to a conformal factor. The L1 metric is a specific choice.",
      "status": "PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "record_id": "r8",
      "carrier": "Counterexample fixture 1: null envelope",
      "kind": "calculation",
      "expression": "c=1,t=1,x=(1,1), dilation factor 2 => a*v_hop(a)*t = 2*1*1=2. ||x||_1 = 2. Exponent: -mu_a(2-2)/a = 0. E_a = C_a
